turns.text: Hi! This is Adriene with the Senior Resource Center — I'm calling about Medicare benefits in your area. Did I catch you at a good time?
Understood. Just to be sure I've got this right — do you currently have Medicare?
wait, what does Medicare Part A actually cover?

Happy to explain! Part A is hospital insurance — it covers inpatient hospital stays, skilled nursing after a hospital stay, hospice, and some home health. Most people don't pay a monthly premium for Part A. Got it. And do you have Medicare already?
